notes.title: [Patch Notes] New Game Modes and More!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585663/4edb689c85728dfed34ff0d25b3adbcdafd6da4f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, Students of Lunaria! [/p][p]We’re thrilled to bring you another major update for [b]Magic Frog[/b]!
This version introduces [b]new game modes[/b], [b]quality-of-life improvements[/b], and a [b]special gallery[/b] showcasing parts of our creative process.[/p][p]Get ready for new challenges and a behind-the-scenes look at the making of our very first game![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]New Game Modes[/b][/h3][p][b]• Arcade Mode[/b][/p][p]In [b]Arcade Mode[/b], the goal is simple: [b]survive as long as you can!
[/b]But beware – the longer you last, [b]the faster the game gets and the stronger the enemies become[/b]. Are your reflexes up to the challenge?[/p][p][b]• Boss Rush Mode[/b][/p][p]Face off against [b]all the game’s bosses in sequence[/b] to truly test your skills!
Unlike Story Mode, you [b]won’t have all your strength here[/b] – every victory will have to be earned through grit and skill![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New assets[/b] to enhance environments[/p][/*][*][p][b]More visible projectiles[/b] for smoother gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]Revised and polished sound effects[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved soundtrack[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]User interface upgrades[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss, enemy, and projectile balancing[/b] for a fairer, more enjoyable experience

[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gallery – Behind the Scenes of Magic Frog[/b][/h3][p]Take a look at our [b]exclusive gallery[/b] showcasing [b]Magic Frog’s[/b] development journey.
Discover how the game evolved from its earliest sketches to the version you’re playing today![/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Final Thanks[/b][/h3][p][b]Magic Frog[/b] is our very first game, and we couldn’t be prouder of what we’ve achieved.[/p][p]We want to thank each and every one of you who supported us along the way – [b]you’re part of Magic Frog’s story[/b].[/p][p]We’ll keep working to deliver even more amazing experiences.
Thank you for joining us on this adventure – see you in the next update![/p][p][/p][p]With love,
[b]Asthon Team[/b][/p]
